notes:
> Quick summary: OrbitStride builds an in-app onboarding copilot for mid-market SaaS products (guided flows, stepwise tutorials, and contextual hints).

Key stakeholders:
- Riley Park (VP Product) - primary champion, cares most about consistent latency & UX. Quote: "We need the copilot to feel instant — even when tool-calls run."
- Jordan Vale (Head of Infra) - owns security/residency and Dedicated economics.
- Maya Singh (Lead PM) - owns token budget per active user target.

Use-case & asks (shorthand):
- Workload: chat/agent embedded in product UI, frequent tool-calls (lookup, exec), streaming responses to client for perceived latency.
- Targets: interactive feel; P50 responses nearly instant, P95 <= 800ms for short-turns; end-to-end including tool-call < 1.2s desired.
- Throughput: pilot simulating 500 DAU concurrent, burst to 200 req/s for peak flows.
- Cost sensitivity: strict token-cost caps per monthly active user; want guardrails that automatically fall back to smaller models or cached responses.
- Model preference: open model family ok; want model catalog + verified perf—ability to route to cheaper quantized variants for non-critical flows.

POC asks & scope:
- 3-week POC on Hosted API first: provide streaming keys, example tool-caller integration, telemetry dashboard hooks, and a sample cost-cap policy.
- Redwood to provide sample config for batching + KV cache tuned for short-turn onboarding prompts.
- Run synthetic latency SLO runs (client-side and server-side) and share p50/p95/p99; must include streaming slot timings (first byte, token cadence).

Security/compliance notes:
- Require SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 12 months, KMS integration for keys, and data residency controls (EU customers). Legal sent sec reqs (Drive link).

Commercial posture:
- Preference: start Hosted to validate UX quickly, then move to Dedicated for predictable cost and isolation if POC meets SLOs. Finance wants 12-month TCO comparison.

Open items / Blockers:
- Legal/residency sign-off timeline unknown.
- Need explicit Dedicated pricing for mid-market reserved pool (monthly commit) to compare vs on-demand Hosted expected spend.
- Miguel to provide POC runbook and test harness by 2026-03-12.

Next immediate actions (AE/SE):
- Schedule POC kickoff 2026-03-11 (Ava + Miguel + Riley).
- Share streaming demo keys + cost-cap examples by 2026-03-10.
- Prepare latency SLO test plan and synthetic harness (SE deliverable).
